title: AI across workplace functions
why: Recognize useful AI patterns across professions and connect learning to real work.

images.headline: AI across workplace functions
images.prompt:
Create ONE finished premium educational presentation slide image, strictly landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This is part of a matched 100-concept Data Science Masterminds Agentic Accelerator V3 APEX series. Style: Apple-inspired restraint, polished friendly 3D objects with subtle realistic studio lighting, generous negative space, deep navy background #041B36 fading very subtly to near-black #020B18, white text #F7F8FC, restrained amber #F2A541 emphasis and teal #5EC4B6 secondary details. No excessive glow, no clutter, no stock-photo collage, no Apple logos. Typography Space Grotesk-like modern clean headings and Inter-like body. Large perfectly legible accurate English text, professionally typeset. One main idea per slide. Layout: tiny uppercase amber section/category and concept number at upper left around 6% margin; very large white headline upper-left across upper fifth; supporting sentence underneath, then dominant central visual in middle 55%; one discreet footer baseline in bottom 7%, containing left 'Data Science Masterminds', center 'Agentic Accelerator', right 'Kunaal Naik & Arpan Saxena'. Keep ample padding so nothing clipped. Footer small but readable. Exact correct author spelling. Do not put V3 APEX or prices on slide. All illustrations original. Where analogy is used include tiny 'Analogy' label near illustration. Do not include any text beyond the specified heading, supporting sentence, labels and footer. Maintain visual consistency across series.

CHAPTER INDEX image, overriding single-concept layout. Top eyebrow 'CHAPTER 10'. Large headline 'AI across workplace functions'. Supporting sentence 'Recognize useful AI patterns across professions and connect learning to real work.'. Main body is a highly readable, spacious two-column index with 4 rows per column. EXACT entries in ascending order: 077 · Document workflows; 078 · Data-analysis workflows; 079 · Decision dashboards; 080 · Multimedia production workflows; 081 · HR and recruitment support; 082 · Finance exception handling; 083 · Operations and project coordination; 084 · AI-assisted software delivery. All 8 entries must be present once, perfectly spelled. Minimal small elegant chapter icon if room; prioritize readable typography, no complicated central illustration. Exact footer. No extra promotional text.
images.review_notes: Visually reviewed: all 8 topic IDs and names complete, chapter rationale readable, author attribution correct.
